name: github-repo-analyzer
description: Analyze GitHub repositories for health, tech stack conformance, structured issue reviews with CWE/OWASP/NIST security classification, HITL code fix suggestions with embedded security reference catalog, and closure verification audits that detect unfixed issues marked as resolved. Runs a graphify knowledge graph as the first step of deep analysis (keyless code-only by default, named/multimodal when an LLM key is available) to ground architecture and technical-debt findings, with graceful fallback to a plain tree walk. Built for MoxyWolf LLC internal use.
